<notes>
All three base rollouts deliver the correct answer "Saturday" using the same approach: divide 521 by 7 to get remainder 3, then count 3 days forward from Wednesday. The extraction logic (last non-empty line) correctly captures this from the model output. 

The harness succeeds completely:
- All runs converge on the same result (no divergence to resolve)
- No repeated failures or omissions are visible
- No risk is evident in the trajectories
- The setup is minimal: one LLM call, ~1700 tokens, delivered in one step

The task itself requires only modular arithmetic (day-of-week cycle), which a direct LLM call handles efficiently. The current system prompt and task prompt are appropriate and transparent.

Adding instruction, separate model calls, helper code, or on-demand components would increase cost without addressing any failure or ambiguity in the evidence. The instruction is explicit: "Do not fix what the runs already got right."

This is a case where the baseline harness is already well-adapted to the task.
</notes>

KEEP_BASE
